verdict.rationale: Pulley's help center has an article on downloading an Excel file of the cap table, and it says cap tables can be downloaded as of a specific date or for all time. That covers the core cap-table export to an open format. Nothing in the evidence shows an export of the full transaction or ledger history, or CSV output. missing for 10: documented export of full transaction history, CSV format support, confirmation that exports include all security types and stakeholder details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
